original.statement: ServiceMonitor v1 schema adds optional field spec.serviceDiscoveryRole to explicitly set the service discovery role (Endpoints or EndpointSlice) for target discovery, defaulting to the value in the referenced Prometheus/PrometheusAgent resource if unset.

decision.reason: [ev-557f479305b6] shows that spec.serviceDiscoveryRole was added to the monitoring.coreos.com/v1 ServiceMonitor schema between 0.85.0 and 0.86.2. It is an optional enum (Endpoints/EndpointSlice). When it is unset, it falls back to the value in the Prometheus/PrometheusAgent resource, so existing objects behave as before. The only environments that touch this subject are those using ServiceMonitor v1, and the consequence for them is none. That makes gvk-in-use{monitoring.coreos.com, v1, ServiceMonitor} a fitting scope, and no narrower predicate follows from the evidence. The canonical validator found no standard shape for an added CRD field, so it neither confirms nor contradicts this condition.
